items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 71:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the power of the Nukva? The Nukva, from her root, has no share at all in the Mochin of AB, for they come out only upon the MAN of the Mazal, which are the aspect of the first restriction, which lower the lower Hey from the eyes to the mouth, as in the first restriction, as is known. And they are not the aspect of the actual Malchut of the first restriction, for it is hidden in the unknown head (Reisha de-Lo Ityada), but they are the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, which is the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, as is known. And thus the Nukva, who has a share only in the Malchut of Ima, which is the aspect of the second restriction, has no one from whom to receive the aspect of the mouth of the first restriction, so that the lower Hey would descend from her aspect of the eyes to the mouth. And therefore she has no power of GAR at all. However, by the Mochin of the Nesira, when she is included in the Malchut of ZA, by the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach, as above in Answer 6, then she receives into her Yesod this spirit of the first union, which is the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, which is the aspect of the male MAN. And then the Yesod of the Nukva acquires the power of GAR also in her Yesod, and she becomes a vessel for the drawing of the GAR of the souls. And this aspect of the vessel, which she attained by the illumination of this spirit called Benjamin, is called by her Ben Oni, for Oni is the aspect of the power of birth. For without this spirit, there would not be in her the power of birth for the GAR of the souls. And therefore this is discerned in her as the aspect of “the power of the Nukva”, meaning the power of the Nukva for the birth of souls. See above, in Answers 13 and 17. (Item 105).
